name: ns_proofsearch_residual_defect_packet_certificate
rubric_version_reason: Successor theorem-search substrate after ns_proofsearch_resupply_pincer iter 3 reranked the dynamic-realization node to residual-defect packet transfer. v0.2 pulls forward sign, cycle-margin, pressure-reconstruction, and return-time obligations so the run does not stop at a conditional Gronwall lemma.
description: Bounded ZTARE theorem attempt for residual-stable supercritical packet certificates, full ratchet/exhaust stack exclusions, or no-go/reranking theorems.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative theorem-attempt substrate over explicit approximate packet fields and residual-defect transfer.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by theorem burden, counterexample quality, and reranking, not formula gaps.
enable_fit_primitive_reason: Qualitative theorem-search substrate; do not route as numerical fit primitive.
persona: You are a ruthless PDE theorem-search referee in Newton mode. The prior pincer run proved a lesson: supercritical coupled exponent envelopes are only kinematic. The live theorem target is residual-stable dynamic realization, but do not stop at the abstract Gronwall lemma. Pull forward the full bridge stack: explicit approximate packet fields U_n, projected NSE residual R_n, strain budget A_n, observable Lip_n/Margin_n, Defect_n<1, pressure reconstruction, sign coherence, cycle profitability/exhaust margin, and return-time density or summability. Reward theorem packets that construct the full certificate, exclude it by proving the first blocking node, or rerank to a cheaper bridge. Penalize exponent-only arguments, metric-kernel substitution, pointwise P_inst chasing, regularity/blowup overclaims, and any argument that treats approximate fields as exact NSE solutions without a residual estimate.

dimensions.name: Residual-Defect Eigenquestion Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the submission attack Defect_n<1 for explicit packet fields U_n, rather than restating the exponent pincer?

dimensions.name: Approximate Packet Field Specificity
dimensions.description: Does it name or construct U_n, its interval I_n, divergence-free compatibility, packet observable Phi_n, and scale/return assumptions?

dimensions.name: NSE Residual And Strain Control
dimensions.description: Does it correctly handle projected residual R_n, H^{-1} residual norm, viscosity weighting, and strain budget A_n in the Gronwall transfer estimate?

dimensions.name: Observable Margin Transfer
dimensions.description: Does it control Lip_n and Margin_n non-circularly, so the packet property actually transfers to a true NSE solution?

dimensions.name: Full Certificate Stack Ambition
dimensions.description: Does it pull forward pressure reconstruction, sign coherence, cycle profitability/exhaust margin, scale progression, and return-time density/summability, either paying them or proving the first blocking node?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a concrete theorem packet: constructive certificate, residual-instability exclusion, exact no-go/reranking theorem, Lean-facing objects, and next discriminator?

dimensions.name: Pincer And Ratchet Interface
dimensions.description: Does it keep the connection to supercritical burden and the original resupply-escape pincer without overclaiming the final NS consequence?

dimensions.name: Claim Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it avoid claiming NS regularity/blowup or hiding residual PDE burdens?

criteria.Residual_Defect_Eigenquestion_Discipline: Full credit requires centering Defect_n<1 or a theorem showing why it fails; exponent-only pincer arguments are insufficient.
criteria.Approximate_Packet_Field_Specificity: Full credit requires explicit U_n/I_n/Phi_n/return assumptions or a proof that such explicit packets cannot satisfy the target.
criteria.NSE_Residual_And_Strain_Control: Full credit requires correct projected residual, H^{-1} residual norm, viscosity scaling, and Gronwall strain-budget treatment.
criteria.Observable_Margin_Transfer: Full credit requires non-circular Lip_n and Margin_n estimates that preserve the packet observable.
criteria.Full_Certificate_Stack_Ambition: Full credit requires attacking the full downstream stack: pressure reconstruction, sign coherence, cycle margin or exhaust margin, scale progression, and return-time density/summability. A submission may pay the stack, exclude the stack, or prove the first blocking node, but it may not merely assume every hard layer.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a formal theorem packet with hypotheses, conclusion, proof skeleton, exact estimate, Lean-facing objects, and remaining PDE assumptions.
criteria.Pincer_And_Ratchet_Interface: Full credit requires explaining how the residual certificate interacts with supercritical burden and later sign/profit/return-time obligations.
criteria.Claim_Discipline: Reject regularity/blowup overclaims, approximate-equals-exact laundering, metric-kernel substitution, and hidden recurrence burdens.
